patches.reason: character roster builder: after cmp edi,9 (MapMaker), cmp [0x78ADAE],2 (sub-mode Story -> one fixed Cortez entry per player) reads the gate byte 0x00903500 instead; pc_mapmaker_story_char_roster (this function) sets it to the sub-mode, or 0 (the Arcade roster of unlocked characters) with TSFP_MAPMAKER_LIMITS=1

carousel init: MapMaker Story previews Cortez (sub_002C4310 ecx=0xC); through the gate byte it starts on the profile's last choice (+0x60/+0x64) as Arcade does; pc_mapmaker_story_char_preview sets the gate

carousel confirm: MapMaker Story skips storing the choice in the profile (+0x60/+0x64) and player record 0x777344; through the gate byte it stores it as Arcade does; pc_mapmaker_story_char_confirm sets the gate

config builder: MapMaker Story writes character 0xC (Cortez) for every local player; through the gate byte it takes the profile's choice and variant (sub_00069620(i)+0x60/+0x64) as Arcade does; pc_mapmaker_story_char_config sets the gate
